rules.statement: A person can claim a way of necessity for the purpose of going from one land owned by him to another, but such a right will not be granted if there is an alternative route, even if it may be less convenient and involve a longer journey.
rules.supporting_quote: "The right of way will not be granted, if there is an alternative route to the one claimed although such route may be less convenient and involve a longer and more arduous journey."
